source_vs_candidate_scope_delta.source_atom_exact_meaning: Do not commit a late result from an expired run.
source_vs_candidate_scope_delta.candidate_scope: For one existing assignment/attempt, a late or duplicate result after timeout, cancel, deadline/lease expiry, process exit, or another terminal result already defined by existing OS contracts does not alter the finalized terminal state or become an accepted/current result; mismatched attempt/source/revision results stay rejected or unknown/stale.
source_vs_candidate_scope_delta.generalization: Candidate extends the literal expired-run source condition to terminal causes already recognized by existing contracts and adds duplicate/mismatch handling. It creates no terminal kind, supervisor, transport, message protocol, or runtime behavior.
source_vs_candidate_scope_delta.source_oracle_context: HR-FR-HIL-12 and HAC-HIL-12a/b/c include late-after-cancel/timeout oracle context, but those are historical supporting materials and not a PO disposition of the candidate generalization.

human_decision_options.choice: 採択候補の限定一般化
human_decision_options.meaning: 対象revision付きでL2/L11-115を採択し、timeout/cancel/lease・deadline expiry/process exitに加え、既存OS contractが既に終端と定義している原因までに限定して適用する。同一attemptのduplicate/mismatched late-resultも扱う。この判断だけから新しいterminal原因を追加しない。
human_decision_options.recommendation: 推奨。旧expiry拒否を保持し、HR/HAC/HATにあるcancel/timeout文脈と既存契約が明示する終端状態までの限定scopeで扱える。

human_decision_options.recommendation: 選ぶ場合はL2/L11-115をこの範囲へ訂正してから採択対象とする。
